title: Log-space bound from an exponential bound
statement: Define $\ell(v)=\lfloor\log_2 v\rfloor+1$ for positive integers $v$, and set $\ell(0)=1$. If $v\le A2^s$ and $1\le s$, then $\ell(v)\le(A+1)s$.
